brief:
The mayor of Karmel has taken steps to address the municipality's financial challenges by appealing to the monetary authority, the Ma'an news agency reported. The move comes as the local government confronts mounting fiscal pressures affecting service delivery and operations.

Details on the specific measures requested or the authority's response were not immediately available. The initiative reflects ongoing financial strain facing Palestinian municipalities amid broader economic constraints.
title: Karmel mayor seeks financial relief through monetary authority
